title: Improved method for qualitative screening of lipolytic bacterial strains
author: Carrazco-Palafox, Rivera-Chavira, et al.
materials: Culture agar was TBA, containing 15 g bacteriological agar (BD), 3 g yeast extract (BBL, Mexico), 5 g peptone (BBL, Mexico), tributyrin 1% v/v (Sigma-Aldrich, St. Louis, MO), modified by adding Ca++ (CaCl2) and/or Mg++ (MgSO4). A full factorial design, with concentrations of calcium and magnesium ions (0.0 mM, 2.5 mM, 5.0 mM, and 10.0 mM in distilled water) was used to test the efficiency of metallic ions on mTBA performance.

steps.title: Maintain and sub‑culture bacterial isolates
steps.instruction: Keep all isolates on tripticasein soy agar (Bioxon, Becton, Dickinson and Company, Franklin Lakes, NJ) at room temperature; sub‑culture each strain in tripticasein soy broth (BD) at 37 °C for 20–24 h before the assay. Maintain control strains (Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC 27853, Bacillus subtilis ATCC 6633, Staphylococcus aureus ATCC 6538, Proteus mirabilis ATCC 12453) under the same conditions.

steps.title: Prepare modified TBA agar (mTBA)
steps.instruction: For each calcium/magnesium level (0, 2.5, 5, 10 mM), dissolve 15 g bacteriological agar (BD), 3 g yeast extract (BBL, Mexico), and 5 g peptone (BBL, Mexico) in distilled water, add tributyrin to a final concentration of 1 % v/v (Sigma‑Aldrich), then add CaCl₂ and/or MgSO₄ to reach the required ion concentration. Autoclave, cool to ~50 °C, pour into sterile Petri dishes, and allow to solidify.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 15 g agar, 3 g yeast extract, and 5 g peptone.
Add CaCl₂ and/or MgSO₄ to obtain 0, 2.5, 5, or 10 mM concentrations.
Cool to ~50 °C, pour into plates, let solidify.

steps.title: Create wells in solidified mTBA
steps.instruction: Using sterilized glass Pasteur pipettes, cut 0.6 cm diameter wells into each agar plate.

steps.title: Inoculate wells with bacterial culture
steps.instruction: Place 20 µL of a 24‑h bacterial culture (≈1–2 × 10⁷ cells) into each well.

steps.title: Measure halo diameters
steps.instruction: Prepare 22 replicate plates for each treatment and control. At 12 h, 24 h, and 48 h after incubation, measure the diameter of the clear zone (halo) around each well as the lipolysis indicator.
